For non-governmental service contracts: Copy of work orders and its work completion certificates along w ith TDS- Form 16/ FORM No.26 AS / Tax certificate/GST return to the extent of value of work experience. Definition of similar service/work contracts - “Service provider of excavation or loading and transport ation or dredging or refilling of any sand or gravel or morum or boulders.”

PQ-2: Prior Turnover Criteria: The average annual turnover of the bidder for the last three consecutive financial years ending on 31.03.2 026 shall be at least Rs.1,20,78,000/- (30% of estimated value excluding GST). If financial details are not s ubmitted for any of the years, the turnover will be calculated by dividing the total turnover as per the sub mitted documents by three. Documents to be submitted: Bidder shall submit financial standing through latest Income Tax return (I TR)/ Annual report containing balance sheet and audited statement of profit & loss account for the relevant periods. In case the date of constitution/ incorporation of the bidder is less than three years old, the average turnov er in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for t his criterion. The bidder will be disqualified if the annualized concurrent commitments of the bidder plus annualized esti mated value of the work under consideration exceeds 4 times the average annual turnover of the precedin g 3 years. The bidder shall submit financial standing through latest Income Tax return (ITR)/ Annual report containing balance sheet and statement of profit & loss account for the relevant periods. The bids qualifying PQ-1, PQ-2, & PQ-3 only will be considered for further processing. Period of Contract The period of contract will be Six(6) months from the date of commencement of th e work. The contractor should expeditiously settle all the local issues related t o the transportation work at his own risk and cost. Payment Terms Payment to contractor will be made on monthly basis within one month after submis sion of bills and after the work done is certified by Engineer –In Charge. All payments will be subjected to deduction of income tax at source at the prevailin g rate of tax as per the income tax act. Payments will be made through e-payment. The contractor has to daily engage 80 or more members of IREL MACCWWF for loadi ng of raw sand as directed by the Engineer in Charge. IREL shall transfer Rs. 600/- for every tonne of raw sand transported to Spiral plant at VT to the foru m against the invoice submitted by the contractor. During the period of contract, In the event of revision in the wages of foru m members, the contractor shall pay the revised rates to the Forum an d IREL shall reimburse such increases. Even in case of decrease in the r ate, the work order will be amended accordingly. All other terms and conditions of the tender document shall be applicable. .
